countries.name: Japan
countries.method: Sum of per-prefecture facility counts on rockgym.jp (579 in Nov 2025, all 47 prefecture pages fetched) cross-checked with trade press (500-600 in 2025) and older Google-Maps style counts (666 in 2020, ~800 JMSCA 2021 incl. sports-centre walls); mid discounts the directory total ~7% for lead-only/public-facility walls and closures.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.method: No national census found. Anchors: Seoul about 60 gyms in 2020, then 140+ bouldering gyms on Kakao Map in Jan 2024 (Korea Herald); 285 nationwide in 2016 (Climbing Business Journal); Seoul metro assumed 25-30% of national, extrapolated to the 2026 boom. The MCST 2024 sports-facility statistics (artificial climbing wall category) exist as PDF but were not downloaded.

Bouldering-only gyms are 52.8% of facilities, so almost all count.
